title: ULRC Operating System: Language, Refusal, Translation, and Honest Contact

tier_0: Grammar of contact: meaning-object preservation across collapse, translation, refusal, critique, reader change, compression, and public exposure; refusal logic, translation discipline, critique posture, contact states, misread types, and repair procedures.

source_role: Meaning / contact / translation / refusal / critique / repair source; language fluency is not closure or proof (handoff manifest).
scope: The functional system that keeps language contact-bearing before evaluation begins, fixed as both source-of-truth reference and practical reading/writing manual.
non_goal: Not a final-stance engine, not a replacement for UMCP, and not a general communication theory; fluent language is not evaluable closure.
notes: Shared packet DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21212668 (coordinated four-paper release); the DOI identifies the archive, the record identifies the member work.
